'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jon Hollingsworth LS notepad list''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jon Hollingsworth]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: Not a deck form - a handwritten notepad list in heavy shorthand with xN counts (same notepad and hand as p051). Every item is written as it appears, unlinked; the card count cannot be confirmed. A margin note beside the shields reads "Jabba's Prize"(?). "Antilles Alien..." x2 is partly struck. Cleanup is left for later.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' WYS v
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
